description: TigerShark Science develops advanced in-vitro skin models grown from human stem cells to reduce animal testing in biomedical research.

prior_companies: Fraunhofer Institute for Silicate Research ISC
Fraunhofer Translational Center for Regenerative Therapies (TLC-RT)
founders_enriched.source_of_identity: Biologist and project manager at the Fraunhofer TLC-RT.
Group manager for in-vitro skin testing systems at the Fraunhofer TLC-RT.

funding_summary: Secured €1.3 million in funding through the EXIST Transfer of Research program.
inflection_why_now: With increasing ethical concerns over animal testing and advancements in tissue engineering, the demand for reliable in-vitro models is at an all-time high.
devils_advocate_risks: Challenges in scaling the production of complex skin models to meet industry demands.
Potential regulatory hurdles in validating and standardizing new in-vitro testing methods.

lp_synergy_matches.reason: Evonik specializes in specialty chemicals and materials, aligning with TigerShark Science's focus on advanced skin models for pharmaceutical and cosmetic applications.
Boehringer Ingelheim is a global pharmaceutical company, making it a strategic partner for TigerShark Science's in-vitro skin models used in drug testing.
